Only two notes (one hold) make the preview feel empty and static, and the notes' rounded corners read as smooth neon rather than pixel. The 'ONLINE' badge is off-brief noise for an arcade rhythm title. Clarity & Hierarchy: Title→START flow is strong, but the left column stacks too many mid-weight items (eyebrow, tagline, two buttons, key hints, three stat cards) with no visual rest; the stat cards (TRACKS 24 / DIFFICULTY 4 / HI-SCORE 999,999) are filler that competes with the CTA, and the top bar's four badges (v1.0, ONLINE, ARCADE MODE, VOL) fragment attention further. The [D][F][J][K] hints are not color-mapped to the receptors, so the core control-to-lane relationship is unclear. Visual System & Craft: The identity is split between pixel and smooth — pixel title and button frame vs. smooth circular receptors, rounded note bars, a soft radial glow that smudges into a visible box behind 'DANCE', and a gray-blue title extrusion that falls outside the neon palette. The hit line is a thin flat white rule with no per-lane ticks; receptors are generic target rings. Monospace body text aids legibility but weakens the committed pixel-typography ask. Expressiveness: Synthwave cues (grid, horizon glow, starfield) are present but stock; nothing pulses to the stated 142 BPM, so the 'rhythm' promise is unfulfilled on a menu screen, and the composition leaves a large dead zone above the title while the bottom-left crowds. history.suggestion: Prioritized plan: 1) Make the highway read as four lanes — draw exactly four lane dividers aligned to the receptors, replace circular receptors with pixel-stepped rings and square/stepped notes (keep the hold), add 3–4 more notes across lanes, and upgrade the hit line to a glowing pixel rule with per-lane [D][F][J][K] ticks color-matched to each receptor. 2) Commit the pixel system — rebuild the title extrusion as a hard two-step offset in palette colors (deep violet + mid magenta/cyan) instead of gray, replace the soft radial smudge with a quantized multi-step box-shadow glow, and add a full-screen scanline/CRT vignette overlay to unify the screen. 3) Rebalance hierarchy — reduce the top bar to logo + volume (fold v1.0/ARCADE MODE into one muted tag, drop ONLINE), collapse the three stat cards into a single muted micro-line under the key hints, and keep START as the only saturated element (OPTIONS stays outline-only). 4) Typography — set the eyebrow, panel headers, and stat labels in the pixel font at a legible size; reserve monospace for the tagline only. 5) Add a beat — pure-CSS animation: hit line and receptors pulse at 142 BPM, horizon glow shimmers, notes drift slowly toward the line, making the menu feel like the game while remaining fully self-contained.
